description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractUserRole' within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing user roles, permissions, and access control mechanisms in the HR management system. It includes methods for retrieving accessible entities, permissions, and employee-related information, and leverages traits for authentication and user services.

classes.name: AbstractUserRole
classes.description: An abstract class that provides foundational user role management functionalities, including permission checks and entity access control, which can be extended for specific role implementations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the user role with role name and role manager.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the authenticated user.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntities
methods.description: Deprecated method intended to retrieve accessible entities of specific types based on permissions; currently throws an exception.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityProperties
methods.description: Deprecated method aimed at retrieving properties of accessible entities; currently throws an exception.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityIds
methods.description: Returns a list of IDs for accessible entities of a given type, considering required permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Abstract protected method that must be implemented to retrieve IDs for specific entity types based on permissions.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Returns employees associated with the role; default implementation returns an empty array.

methods.name: getAccessibleProjects
methods.description: Deprecated placeholder method for retrieving accessible projects; currently returns an empty array.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancies
methods.description: Deprecated placeholder method for retrieving accessible vacancies; currently returns an empty array.

methods.name: areRequiredPermissionsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the current user role has the necessary permissions based on data groups and actions.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Returns a list of quick launch items accessible based on permissions; default is empty.
